thread:
anya: starting a short thread for the v5-int4 A/B we flipped at 11:30 UTC. traffic at 1% initially. baseline fp16 vs int4.
mike: initial perf is nice (p95 -30%), but rachel flagged a reproducible token-boundary mismatch on code-gen prompts where indentation tokens are merged.
rachel: yup — sample diffs here: s3://redwood-evals/1723456780/v5-int4/diffs.txt. examples show missing "\n    " sequences and replaced with single-space in some completions.
anya: that smells like quantized embedding or softmax precision affecting tokenizer logits. could also be a fused-kernel truncation.
archi: technical note: the new fused attention kernel changes fp->int accumulation path; small negative logits around whitespace can get rounded.
mike: how does this map to our gating rules? current auto-fallback: any slice quality delta <= -5% triggers rollback. code-gen is a targeted slice. fidelity delta on code-gen is -6.1% at 1% traffic.
rachel: we also see hallucination (incoherent code) up +1.5% abs on that slice. global quality -0.8%.
deploy-bot: [ab_report] v5-int4@1%: p95 -30%, median -38%, code-gen fidelity -6.1%, code-gen hallucination +1.5% abs. report: s3://redwood-evals/1723456780/v5-int4/report.html
eng-oncall: recommendation: do not auto-rollback at 1% for this signal; instead increase sampling and run tokenizer-agnostic checks. propose: pause auto-fallback until traffic >=2% unless degradation >10% slice.
anya: agree. propose rerun with: 0.5% canary but an attached 5% shadow sampling for code-gen and long-code slices. keep auto-fallback disabled for hallucination at low traffic, enable slice-alerting.
archi: I'll also run a quick kernel compare with and without fused attention (fallback to reference kernel) to see if rounding path is root cause. if kernel is culprit we may patch fast.
mike: proposed commands:
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v5-int4 --traffic 0.5% --observe 45m --auto-fallback "enabled=false" --notes "investigate-token-boundary"
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v5-int4 --traffic 5% --mode sampling --slices code-gen,long-code
```
rachel: I'll kick off tokenizer-agnostic byte-align eval and a targeted seqlen warmup for kv cache (seqs 2k-8k). posting results in ~30m.
eng-oncall: pager thresholds unchanged: pager on fidelity_delta <= -8% global or hallucination >4% abs sustained 10m. Otherwise post to #eng-ml.
anya: if kernel check fails, fallback plan is to try asymmetric quant scales on projection layers and re-run. if that helps we can promote once code-gen fidelity delta < -3% at 2% traffic.
mike: agree. also add a short-lived lint that rejects canaries with code-gen fidelity <-7% at any traffic without manual approval.
deploy-bot: [action] rollout rlt-1723456780 created by anya: canary 0.5% observe=45m auto-fallback disabled. shadow sampling 5% enabled.
anya: thanks all. keep updates short. we'll reconvene on thread at 12:20 UTC or earlier if deploy-bot posts a rollback event.
